royaltyInfo(uint256,uint256).notice: EIP-2981 — returns receiver and royalty amount for a given sale price.

setData(uint256,uint256).notice: Only the minter (dungeon) may rewrite token data. Previously any token holder could flip arbitrary bits — durability, level, classBits, even skin bits — bypassing the paid `applySkin` flow and forging gear stats. Player-initiated mutations must go through purpose-built functions (e.g. Gears.applySkin) that mask only the fields the player is allowed to change.
